children: BRIDGEWATER, N.J., Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Signify, the world leader in lighting, announces that Philips Skylight ceiling lighting is now available in the U.S. through Amazon and will be available at select Home Depot locations beginning in early November.

Designed to recreate the brightness, depth and rhythm of natural daylight indoors, Philips Skylight uses Signify's NatureConnect technology to create the visual impression of daylight at home. Its auto day rhythm feature adjusts brightness and tone throughout the day, while five preset scenes allow users to customize their lighting.

Philips Skylight is available in two variants: Philips Skylight Medium and Philips Skylight VitaUp Medium. Both feature a slim, surface-mounted profile, remote control, five preset lighting scenes, auto day rhythm functionality and an IP44 rating for bathrooms and damp environments.

Philips Skylight VitaUp also includes an integrated UV-B module designed to support the body's natural vitamin D production indoors, with automatic shut-off after eight hours or manual control through the included remote.
